integrity: One analytic theorem with a distinct supplementary finite numerical verifier; prior five-site smooth bicone construction expressly credited. Historical priority remains provisional and independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: The four-site nonzero inclusion-exclusion error uses the nonsmooth bicone p=1; the uniform nerve statement covers only the stated symmetric configuration. Positive error is proved on a sufficient open range, not characterized everywhere. No global minimality among arbitrary site configurations or norms is claimed.
title: A singular four-site Voronoi-nerve transition for product balls
